name: Malformed early packets are dropped and the session keeps working
contract: Ascension packets are handled by CanPacketReceiveEarly on the socket thread, where an escaping exception terminates the worldserver. A payload too short or not valid UTF-8 for its handler must be dropped there instead: a one-byte 0xC2 character sort order (CMSG 0x0772), a one-byte CMSG_QUERY_CUSTOM_STORE (0x06B9) and a CMSG_PURCHASE_CUSTOM_STORE_ITEM (0x06BB) carrying only its key. Expected: each is consumed without an error reaching the caller, and a well-formed store query sent afterwards is still answered with QUERY_CUSTOM_STORE_OK (SMSG 0x06BA).

steps.label: Sort order that is not a valid string
Store query without its store id
A well-formed query for a store nobody serves
